result.instructions: Tools for SendPost, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Compare delivery and hard-bounce counts for the past week across my SendPost sub-accounts."; "List my sending IPs and identify which ones are still warming up."; "Check the DNS verification status of my sending domains.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SendPost data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sendpost_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sendpost_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sendpost_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. sendpost_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sendpost_list_subaccounts
tools.title: List SendPost sub-accounts
tools.description: READ (account key): List sub-accounts and safe account metadata. API keys and SMTP credentials are never returned.

tools.name: sendpost_get_subaccount
tools.title: Get SendPost sub-account
tools.description: READ (account key): Get a sub-account's safe metadata, labels and blocked state. Credentials are excluded.

tools.name: sendpost_list_ips
tools.title: List SendPost sending IPs
tools.description: READ (account key): List sending IPs, warmup and state metadata. Does not allocate or change IPs.

tools.name: sendpost_get_ip
tools.title: Get SendPost sending IP
tools.description: READ (account key): Inspect an existing sending IP's public address, reverse DNS and warmup state.

tools.name: sendpost_list_ip_pools
tools.title: List SendPost IP pools
tools.description: READ (account key): List IP pool names, routing strategy, overflow settings and safe public IP metadata.

tools.name: sendpost_get_ip_pool
tools.title: Get SendPost IP pool
tools.description: READ (account key): Inspect one IP pool's routing strategy, overflow settings and public IP metadata. Provider credentials and routing internals are excluded.

tools.name: sendpost_list_account_stats
tools.title: List SendPost account daily statistics
tools.description: READ (account key): Daily delivery, bounce, open, click, unsubscribe and spam counts across sub-accounts. Use up to 366 days per call.

tools.name: sendpost_get_account_stats
tools.title: Get SendPost account aggregate statistics
tools.description: READ (account key): Aggregate delivery and engagement counts across sub-accounts over a date range, up to 366 days.

tools.name: sendpost_get_account_group_stats
tools.title: Get SendPost account group statistics
tools.description: READ (account key): Aggregate delivery and engagement counts for an existing group/tag across sub-accounts, up to 366 days.

group.description: Existing message group/tag, for example transactional.

tools.name: sendpost_list_subaccount_stats
tools.title: List SendPost sub-account statistics
tools.description: READ (account key): Read a sub-account's delivery and engagement statistic records for a date range, up to 366 days.

tools.name: sendpost_get_subaccount_stats
tools.title: Get SendPost sub-account aggregate statistics
tools.description: READ (account key): Aggregate delivery and engagement counts for one sub-account over a date range, up to 366 days.

tools.name: sendpost_get_message_metadata
tools.title: Get SendPost message metadata
tools.description: READ (account key): Inspect a submitted message's ID, sender, recipient, subject, groups and routing metadata. Excludes bodies, attachments, custom headers and recipient custom fields. Large messages may exceed the 1 MiB read limit.

tools.name: sendpost_list_domains
tools.title: List SendPost sending domains
tools.description: READ (sub-account key): Audit sending domains, DNS record configuration and verification failures. Does not create or verify domains.

tools.name: sendpost_get_domain
tools.title: Get SendPost sending domain
tools.description: READ (sub-account key): Inspect a sending domain's DNS records and verification status.

tools.name: sendpost_list_suppressions
tools.title: List SendPost suppressed recipients
tools.description: READ (sub-account key): Inspect suppressions and documented reasons within a date range, with pagination. Does not add or remove suppressions.
